```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
usa_data <- data.frame(
  State = rep(c("CA", "FL", "TX", "NY"), each = 4),
  Age_Group = rep(c("0-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+"), times = 4),
  Effect_Category = rep(c("Poisoning", "Liver & Pancreas", "Heart Disease", "100% Alcohol-Attributable"), times = 4),
  Deaths = c(500, 1200, 1366, 2203, 300, 900, 1315, 1800, 
             400, 1000, 884, 1600, 250, 825, 600, 1400)
)

pastel_colors <- c("Poisoning" = "lightblue", 
                   "Liver & Pancreas" = "steelblue",
                   "Heart Disease" = "blue",  # Soft blue
                   "100% Alcohol-Attributable" = "darkblue")  

ggplot(usa_data, aes(x = Age_Group, y = Deaths, fill = Effect_Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ State) +  
  labs(title = "Alcohol-Related Deaths by Effect Category and Age Group",
       x = "Age Group", 
       y = "Number of Deaths",
       fill = "Effect Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pastel_colors) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
